findings.description: Carel Fredrik Kolbe died on 21 February 1876 and was buried in Cape Town; the Dutch Reformed Church burial entry indexes him as Carel Fredrik Kolbey and gives no age or relatives.

details.place: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa

supporting_sources: "South Africa, Dutch Reformed Church Registers (Cape Town Archives), 1660-1994", database, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:6P1Y-82HK), entry for Carel Fredrik Kolbey, died 21 Feb 1876, buried Cape Town 1876; from the Cape Town congregation's list of deceased members, 1 Oct 1875 - 30 Sep 1877.

Page image of the Cape Town Nederduitsche Gereformeerde Kerk "Naamlyst van Leden ... Overleden", 1 Oct 1875 - 30 Sep 1877, p. 744, entry "Februarij 21 Carel Fredrik Kolbe" (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3Q9M-CSK6-Y315-G): a list of deceased confirmed members, so the entry cannot be a child.
